jobs.description:
Description: 
 PETA’s Video Lab is a team of creative problem-solvers and storytellers behind some of the organization’s most talked-about animal rights videos on social media. From provocative, hilarious content that taps into the cultural conversation to emotionally powerful stories that motivate people to act, the Video Lab creates work that consistently cuts through the noise. Videos produced by PETA’s Video Lab generate roughly 100 million views each year, offering an extraordinary opportunity to experiment with emerging creative technology and make work that has a meaningful impact on animals.


  Position Description:


 PETA’s social channels reach millions of people every week—and this role sits at the center of that impact. As an AI Creative Producer — Social Video, you’ll create visually striking, culturally relevant, and emotionally powerful videos for PETA’s social platforms, with a strong emphasis on AI-assisted animation, original visual storytelling, and self-filmed content.


 Your work will help make PETA’s animal liberation message compelling, shareable, and impossible to ignore—whether through humor and provocative commentary or powerful stories that build empathy for animals and inspire people to take action.


 We’re looking for a highly creative, chronically online producer with strong creative instincts and a genuine connection to PETA’s mission. You should be excited to experiment with emerging AI tools and develop work that can be bold, funny, unexpected, heartbreaking, or moving, all via a new creative medium. Above all, you should understand that technology is a tool for telling great stories and helping people see animals as individuals.


  Position Objective:


 Leverage AI tools to create bold content, appear on camera, create skits, commentary, explanatory videos, and more


  Primary Responsibilities and Duties:


 
  Create high-impact videos for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube, and emerging social channels, from concept through final delivery
  Develop scripts and creative concepts that balance humor, cultural relevance, emotional resonance, and provocative storytelling
  Use AI tools such as Midjourney, Runway, Higgsfield, Veo, and similar platforms to create animations, characters, visual effects, and other elements that elevate storytelling
  Experiment with emerging AI-powered video, animation, and creative technologies to develop innovative content and formats
  Combine AI-generated elements with traditional editing, animation, self-shot footage, and other production techniques to create the strongest possible story
  Create characters for comedic skits, commentary, explanatory videos, and other original formats that bring PETA’s bold and distinctive voice to life
  Develop emotionally compelling stories that build empathy for animals, help audiences see them as individuals, and motivate people to take action
  Self-film content when needed, using an iPhone or similar equipment, taking ownership of lighting, sound, props, set design, and overall production quality
  Direct and produce formal shoots as needed
  Collaborate closely with Video Lab team members and the social media team to develop timely, engaging content
  Ensure all video content meets quality standards and complies with legal and brand guidelines
  Stay current on social media trends, platform updates, internet culture, and advancements in AI creative tools
  Requirements: 
 
  Degree in a related field, relevant professional experience, or a portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative ability
  Portfolio showcasing generative AI work, creative video projects, or personal AI-driven experiments. We care about what you’ve made, whether it comes from professional work, social content, animations, spec pieces, short films, or personal projects
  Demonstrated experience using AI tools for video generation, animation, visual effects, or video enhancement
  Strong understanding of visual storytelling and all stages of video production, from concept development through post-production
  Excellent video-editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or comparable tools
  Familiarity with video, lighting, and photography equipment
  Excellent creative instincts and enthusiasm for bold, unconventional ideas, balanced with the judgment and empathy needed to tell sensitive and emotionally powerful stories
  Strong understanding of social media and what makes audiences stop, watch, feel, and share
  Curiosity about emerging creative technology and enthusiasm for experimenting with new tools and techniques
  Knowledge of animal rights issues and familiarity with PETA campaigns preferred
  Professional appearance and commitment to a healthy vegan lifestyle
  Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively under tight deadlines, both independently and collaboratively
  Commitment to the mission and objectives of the organization
 
 The hourly pay range for this position is $19.45 - $24.93. The ultimate hourly pay within this range offered to a qualified candidate will be determined by the candidate’s experience.

jobs.title: AI Creative Lead (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision.

Responsibilities



Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. 

Requirements

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. jobs.title: Creative Director, Art (Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
About VIVO
VIVO is a healthcare marketing agency specializing in consumer health, pharma, and medtech. We are a 100% remote agency with team members all around the US. Being 100% remote means we value constant collaboration, clear communication, personal accountability, and proactive problem solvers.
At VIVO, we believe health is more than a sector; it’s a life-changing mission. We are creators and strategists driven to make healthcare impactful and accessible, from first impressions to lifelong connections. We bring insight, curiosity, and compassion to every project, knowing our work helps patients, doctors, and everyone in between get the care they deserve—when and where it’s needed most. We’re here to challenge the norms and elevate health brands to inspire, engage, and transform lives.


About You
VIVO is a growing independent healthcare agency with ambitious plans for what comes next—and we believe exceptional creative will be central to getting us there.
We’re looking for a Creative Director — Art who can raise our creative bar, lead and grow our Art discipline, and help shape the future of Creative at VIVO.


This is a senior leadership role for someone who is as passionate about building as they are about making: building exceptional work, talented teams, strong creative partnerships, better ways of working, and an agency people notice.


You’ll bring deep roots in art and design, but your creative thinking should extend well beyond the visual. You understand how art, copy and strategy come together to create an idea, and you're comfortable helping lead multidisciplinary teams toward work that's strategically smart, beautifully executed and impossible to ignore.


What You Will Do
Set the Creative Bar.

Own and elevate the visual and creative standard across VIVO's client and agency work.
Lead the development of integrated ideas across digital, social, video, print, experiential and emerging channels.
Be hands-on when it matters—reviewing, challenging, refining and elevating work from concept through execution.
Push healthcare creative beyond the expected and help build a body of work that earns attention from clients, talent and our industry.

Lead Art. Influence Creative.

Lead, mentor and develop VIVO's Art and Design talent, creating clarity around expectations, feedback, growth and accountability.
Partner closely with our Creative Director, Copy to create a highly integrated creative organization where Art and Copy make one another better.
Think beyond your own discipline. Bring a strong point of view to concepts, storytelling, creative strategy and the overall quality of our work.
Evolve the structure, capabilities and future of VIVO's Creative department.

Build, Don't Just Maintain.

Identify the talent, capabilities, processes and tools we need for our next stage of growth.
Develop creative leaders—not just great campaigns.
Create an environment where talented people are challenged, supported and able to do the best work of their careers.
Partner Across the Agency.
Work closely with Strategy, Client Services, Project Management, Editorial and Agency Leadership to turn business problems into powerful, creative solutions.
Build trust across disciplines and eliminate the silos that get in the way of great work.
Be someone our teams want in the room for our most important opportunities and our toughest creative challenges.

Help Grow VIVO.

Play a meaningful role in new business, pitches and organic client growth.
Present ideas and creative vision confidently to senior clients.
Identify opportunities to make our existing client work stronger—and our relationships bigger.
Help build VIVO's external creative reputation through award-worthy work, thought leadership and visibility in the industry.

Embrace What's Next.

Bring curiosity—not fear—to emerging technology.
Help us integrate AI and new tools thoughtfully into concepting, design, content development and production while protecting originality, craft and quality.

What You Bring

15+ years of creative experience with deep roots in art direction/design
Significant experience as a Creative Director, Group Creative Director, or equivalent
A portfolio demonstrating exceptional conceptual thinking and visual craft
Strong network of talent and vendor relationships
Experience leading integrated work across art, copy and multiple channels
A track record of building and developing creative talent
The ability to move between big-picture creative vision and hands-on creative direction
Strong executive presence and confidence presenting to senior clients
Experience contributing to pitches, new business and organic growth
Healthcare, pharma, life sciences, diagnostics, medical device or health-tech experience strongly preferred
AI experience and a strong philosophy about how to integrate it across our agency

But the most important thing is how you think. You're a builder. You care about developing people as much as developing ideas. You have high standards without needing to have all the answers yourself. You know the best creative departments aren't built around one person's ego—they're built around talented people who challenge one another and make the work better together. And you're excited by the opportunity to help shape what VIVO becomes next.
What We Bring
VIVO offers an award-winning culture and comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, financial well-being, professional growth, and work-life balance. Our benefits offerings include:

Medical, dental, vision
Company paid disability & life insurance
401k with match up to 6%
Annual wellness stipend
Professional development allowance
Recognition, rewards, prizes and amazing swag
11 Holidays plus Winter Break and Annual In-Person Retreat
3+ weeks of total paid time off in Year 1

Ask our hiring manager and/or HR team for more information about any or all of our benefits.

The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About The Role

Forbes Advisor is hiring a Creative Director of Paid Social to own end-to-end creative across our Health vertical, a portfolio that today includes weight loss medications, hair loss, hearing, TRT, and dating. You will concept, write, direct, and supervise editorial on the paid social and native creative that drives acquisition for Forbes and its partners, and you will lead a pod of creatives doing the same. This is a direct-response storyteller's role layered with creative management responsibility.

The role reports into the VP Creative and partners with our Paid Social and Native Buyers, who direct the spend, and vertical General Managers, who own category outcomes.

The successful candidate is a senior creative leader. You are fluent in the modern direct-response canon, comfortable in regulated health categories, and produce video and copy at performance-marketing pace without sacrificing craft. You have built and led creative teams before, and you can run a small team of senior individual contributors (creative leads and editors) and personally taking on high priority projects yourself. You move fluently across content modes (remote UGC, in-studio and on-location shoots, AI-generated content) and pick the right mode for pipeline needs. Above all, you are equally at home concepting on a page, directing on set, supervising an edit, and reviewing your team's work with sharp, useful notes.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to accelerate output without diluting craft, and you will be expected to operate that way from day one. You can articulate where AI sharpens video storytelling and where it weakens it. In short, AI fluency is a baseline expectation. You already use it to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

 With a $90B market cap, we are a leader in the U.S. banking industry. Throughout seven unique affiliated bank brands who welcome customers at 400 local branches across the West, ZBC is committed to business and commercial banking because we believe that businesses are the cornerstone of thriving communities. Together with consumer banking, wealth services, and robust banking products and services, we are known for our exceptional service and deep local roots.

This is a collaborative hub for meaningful and holistic brand building, bold ideas, and breakthrough campaigns. 



We are adding a key role: A Creative Director for a new digital banking platform designed to move nimbly into the future and transcend our footprint while leveraging the ZBC foundation of strength and stability. The platform will require an equally dynamic creative leader with bright, modern ideas and deep chops in brand design. This is your opportunity to help build the identity of one of the fastest-growing areas of the organization and join us in setting a new standard for performance-driven design and marketing experiences. 




 The Creative Director - Design (Enterprise Marketing) will deliver innovative design and creative direction that prioritize innovation while balancing business goals with brand integrity. They will be a culturally savvy self-starter and systems-thinker who uses data and insights to create compelling, conversion-focused work that positions us as a leader in digital-forward business banking. 




 Initially, this position will lead and execute design and creative leadership within a small, discreet startup team, working directly with leadership, and aligning with Creative Studio executive leaders at regular intervals to ensure holistic brand alignment. 




 Primary Function 


 Act as a leader in the creative visioning, stewardship, and hands-on design of the platform’s brand and its marketing approach. 


 Deliver creative strategy and design of brand assets, guidelines, and marketing campaigns that will strengthen customer trust and drive measurable results across digital, print, physical, and in-person experiences. 


 Collaborate with performance marketing teams and other organizations to optimize creative for ROI, conversion, and sustainment. 




 Leadership and Team Development 


 Work inside a multidisciplinary team and act as the key creative, guiding the work of a designer and writer (more may be added). 


 Regularly connect with and seek direction from Creative Studio. 


 Act as an evangelist for the platform’s brand and its application throughout the enterprise. 


 Demonstrate expert level skills in design tools, methodologies, and production processes, and coach junior members toward the same, fostering a culture of excellence. 


 Establish creative workflows that enhance efficiency and productivity. 


 Maintain an extensive network of creative resources for freelance and recruiting. 




 Brand Building and Stewardship 


 Establish robust brand identity systems that work across many channels, ensuring quality and brand integrity across all touchpoints. 


 Balance innovative approaches with regulatory requirements and financial industry standards. 


 Apply cultural curiosity and cultivate knowledge of current trends in culture, advertising, and the financial sector. 




 Data-Driven Innovation 


 Use performance data and testing insights to refine creative strategies. 


 Track and forecast marketing trends, technologies, and best practices. 




 Vendor and Partner Collaboration 


 Manage relationships with internal stakeholders, external agencies, and production vendors to ensure quality and cost efficiency. 


 Maintain a knowledge of regulatory requirements and ensure application of best practices to avoid risk for the organization and ensure clarity for customers. 


 Operate with organizational savvy in a collaborative, productive manner. 




 QUALIFICATIONS 


 Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in design and minimum 8 years of experience in graphic design, interactive, advertising, media, UX, and/or related fields. 


 Strong visual, written, and oral presentation skills 

Bonus skills: experience with banking services, regulatory environments, transactional design, identity design and/or startups 


 A combination of education and experience may meet job requirements 




 BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION 


 This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $115,000 - $175,000 annually depending on job-related factors such as level of experience and location.

jobs.description:
Job Description



Who We Are



Creative Artists Agency (CAA) is the leading entertainment and sports agency, with global expertise in filmed and live entertainment, digital media, publishing, sponsorship sales and endorsements, licensing, media finance, consumer investing, fashion, trademark licensing, and philanthropy. Distinguished by its culture of collaboration and exceptional client service, CAA's diverse workforce identifies, innovates, and amplifies opportunities for the people and organizations that shape culture and inspire the world. The trailblazer of the agency business, CAA was the first to build a sports business, create an investment bank, launch a venture fund, found technology start-up companies, establish a philanthropic arm, build a business in China, and form a brand marketing services division, among other innovations.



Position Summary:



CAA Brand Consulting is a strategy-led, full-service marketing agency with expertise in Cultural and Consumer Insights, Data and Analytics, Talent/Influencer and Property Partnership Advisory, Experiential, Social Impact, Creative Services, and Content and Digital Strategy. These integrated capabilities come together to offer solutions from planning through execution, and we pull in a collective perspective of expertise with each client brief to ensure we are tapping into diverse thinking and building strategies reflective of the marketplace and culture we work within.



We have an exciting opportunity for a talented and experienced Creative Director, Experiential to join our award-winning international team and play a pivotal role working across sport and entertainment. You will lead, direct, and inspire a talented team to create stand-out, exciting, big ideas and experiences that drive brand love for our client across the worlds of sport and entertainment.



You are a confident self-starter who is currently working as an Experiential Creative Director in a busy agency environment and looking for a new creative challenge. You'll bring that experience and a portfolio of work that demonstrates how you've used creative thinking to help solve a wide range of brand and business challenges. You are a creative team leader adept at thinking in both the visual world and written word and a master at presenting and selling ideas to both clients and account teams. You are hands-on, confident, energetic and ambitious with an entrepreneurial mindset and excited by the opportunity to shape, inspire, and nurture a team of dynamic talent.



Essential Functions:

• Direct all aspects of experiential creative, working with internal and client partners to understand marketing objectives, consumer insights and market research that informs creative strategies and determines how brands show up across sports and entertainment partnerships.

• Manage a team of art directors, designers, and experiential specialists with an energy and positive creative culture that inspires them to bring their A-game every day.

• Lead the development of concepts into detailed, integrated activations and delivery of assets, and oversee the creative install of the activation on-site.

• Partner with account and production teams to develop solutions that satisfy brand goals while delivering against operational schedules and budgets.

• Craft and lead compelling presentations that demonstrate strategic and conceptual thinking leading to client excitement and buy-in.



Requirements

• 12+ years of experience in the Experiential Creative space

• 7+ years creative/experiential/advertising/design agency experience at Associate Creative Director or Creative Director level

• Management experience leading a creative team including writing/conducting performance reviews and delivering positive and constructive feedback

• Demonstrated conceptual thinking and applied design

• A design practitioner who is inspired by the visual world around them and a portfolio of work that demonstrates your creativity and ability to work across multiple marketing channels

• A strategic thinker who offers creative counsel to our account and production team and clients

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships

• Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to work under pressure and against tight deadlines

• A strong understanding of and working experience in partnership marketing

• A passion for new ideas and innovative thinking

• Expert knowledge in graphic design, advertising, branding, customer comms, content and social media

• Expert working technical knowledge of Adobe CC and Microsoft software packages

• Ambitious, and energetic, approaching each day with a can-do attitude

• Ability to multi-task

• A flair for interior design, materiality, prop styling, furniture selection and vignette creation

• Strong fabrication and production knowledge

• A keen eye for detail that sweats the small stuff

• A finger on the pulse and up-to-date knowledge of social, pop-cultural and entertainment industry trends



Location

This role will be located in our New York office. The Brand Consulting department offers a flexible work schedule and requires a minimum of three days per week on-site.



Compensation

The annual base salary for this position is in the range of $188,000 - $230,000. This position is also eligible for benefits and a discretionary bonus. new_jobs.description:
Job Description



Who We Are



Creative Artists Agency (CAA) is the leading entertainment and sports agency, with global expertise in filmed and live entertainment, digital media, publishing, sponsorship sales and endorsements, licensing, media finance, consumer investing, fashion, trademark licensing, and philanthropy. Distinguished by its culture of collaboration and exceptional client service, CAA's diverse workforce identifies, innovates, and amplifies opportunities for the people and organizations that shape culture and inspire the world. The trailblazer of the agency business, CAA was the first to build a sports business, create an investment bank, launch a venture fund, found technology start-up companies, establish a philanthropic arm, build a business in China, and form a brand marketing services division, among other innovations.



Position Summary:



CAA Brand Consulting is a strategy-led, full-service marketing agency with expertise in Cultural and Consumer Insights, Data and Analytics, Talent/Influencer and Property Partnership Advisory, Experiential, Social Impact, Creative Services, and Content and Digital Strategy. These integrated capabilities come together to offer solutions from planning through execution, and we pull in a collective perspective of expertise with each client brief to ensure we are tapping into diverse thinking and building strategies reflective of the marketplace and culture we work within.



We have an exciting opportunity for a talented and experienced Creative Director, Experiential to join our award-winning international team and play a pivotal role working across sport and entertainment. You will lead, direct, and inspire a talented team to create stand-out, exciting, big ideas and experiences that drive brand love for our client across the worlds of sport and entertainment.



You are a confident self-starter who is currently working as an Experiential Creative Director in a busy agency environment and looking for a new creative challenge. You'll bring that experience and a portfolio of work that demonstrates how you've used creative thinking to help solve a wide range of brand and business challenges. You are a creative team leader adept at thinking in both the visual world and written word and a master at presenting and selling ideas to both clients and account teams. You are hands-on, confident, energetic and ambitious with an entrepreneurial mindset and excited by the opportunity to shape, inspire, and nurture a team of dynamic talent.



Essential Functions:

• Direct all aspects of experiential creative, working with internal and client partners to understand marketing objectives, consumer insights and market research that informs creative strategies and determines how brands show up across sports and entertainment partnerships.

• Manage a team of art directors, designers, and experiential specialists with an energy and positive creative culture that inspires them to bring their A-game every day.

• Lead the development of concepts into detailed, integrated activations and delivery of assets, and oversee the creative install of the activation on-site.

• Partner with account and production teams to develop solutions that satisfy brand goals while delivering against operational schedules and budgets.

• Craft and lead compelling presentations that demonstrate strategic and conceptual thinking leading to client excitement and buy-in.



Requirements

• 12+ years of experience in the Experiential Creative space

• 7+ years creative/experiential/advertising/design agency experience at Associate Creative Director or Creative Director level

• Management experience leading a creative team including writing/conducting performance reviews and delivering positive and constructive feedback

• Demonstrated conceptual thinking and applied design

• A design practitioner who is inspired by the visual world around them and a portfolio of work that demonstrates your creativity and ability to work across multiple marketing channels

• A strategic thinker who offers creative counsel to our account and production team and clients

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships

• Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to work under pressure and against tight deadlines

• A strong understanding of and working experience in partnership marketing

• A passion for new ideas and innovative thinking

• Expert knowledge in graphic design, advertising, branding, customer comms, content and social media

• Expert working technical knowledge of Adobe CC and Microsoft software packages

• Ambitious, and energetic, approaching each day with a can-do attitude

• Ability to multi-task

• A flair for interior design, materiality, prop styling, furniture selection and vignette creation

• Strong fabrication and production knowledge

• A keen eye for detail that sweats the small stuff

• A finger on the pulse and up-to-date knowledge of social, pop-cultural and entertainment industry trends



Location

This role will be located in our New York office. The Brand Consulting department offers a flexible work schedule and requires a minimum of three days per week on-site.



Compensation

The annual base salary for this position is in the range of $188,000 - $230,000. This position is also eligible for benefits and a discretionary bonus. Ultimately, the salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience, time in role, business sector, and geographic location, among other criteria.
